formula: Subject + be + all but + adjective / past participle

formulas.formula: Subject + be + all but + adjective / past participle

example: The original agreement is all but forgotten.
exampleZh: 原來的協議幾乎已被遺忘。

examples.en: The original agreement is all but forgotten.
examples.zh: 原來的協議幾乎已被遺忘。
examples.highlight: The original agreement is all but forgotten.

rules.zh: 核心表達是 be + all but + adjective / past participle 核心句式是：【Subject + be + all but + adjective / past participle.】 道路幾乎完全堵塞。 工作差不多完成。 以下內容都只是可選的補充資料，並不是固定句式的一部分：【after midnight；in this region；to repair；without compromise；because of the storm；The town centre will be all but empty after midnight.】 午夜後，市中心將會幾乎空無一人。 這部機器幾乎不可能修理。 這個物種在本區幾乎已經絕種。 核心表達仍然分別是：【be all but empty；be all but impossible；be all but extinct】
rules.en: Subject + be + all but + adjective / past participle. The road is all but blocked. The work is all but finished. after midnight in this region to repair without compromise because of the storm The town centre will be all but empty after midnight. The machine is all but impossible to repair. The species is all but extinct in this region. be all but empty be all but impossible be all but extinct

rules.zh: 動詞須按照主語和時間改變。現在式：協議差不多已經定案。街道幾乎空無一人。過去式：觀眾當時幾乎鴉雀無聲。道路當時幾乎空無一人。將來式及情態動詞：項目到下星期便差不多完成。要取得進一步進展幾乎不可能。這個物種可能已經幾乎絕種。完成式及被動式：該份文件幾乎已被遺忘。該項目當時幾乎已被放棄。房屋當時幾乎已被完全摧毀。 這些句子中的 been 仍然是 be 動詞的一部分。
rules.en: be The agreement is all but final. The streets are all but empty. The audience was all but silent. The roads were all but deserted. Future and modal verbs The project will be all but complete next week. Further progress would be all but impossible. The species may be all but extinct. Perfect and passive forms The document has been all but forgotten. The project had been all but abandoned. The house had been all but destroyed.

rules.zh: 不會改變形容詞本身的正負意思以【all but】為例：的意思是「幾乎」，後面的形容詞仍然保留原來意思。正面或肯定形容詞幾乎肯定結果幾乎已成定局。 負面或否定形容詞幾乎不可能修理這部機器幾乎不可能。 因此：【all but impossible】 不是「幾乎可能」，而是「幾乎不可能」。
rules.en: all but Positive adjective all but certain = almost certain The result is all but certain. Negative adjective all but impossible = almost impossible Repairing the machine is all but impossible. all but impossible

rules.zh: 過去分詞可描述接近完成的狀態常見形式包括：【all but forgotten；all but finished；all but destroyed；all but abandoned；all but blocked；all but eliminated；all but rejected；The language is all but forgotten.】 這種語言幾乎已被遺忘。 建築工程差不多完成。 建議幾乎已被否決。 這類句子通常表示某個過程已經接近完全發生，但仍未達到百分之百。
rules.en: all but forgotten all but finished all but destroyed all but abandoned all but blocked all but eliminated all but rejected The language is all but forgotten. The building is all but finished. The proposal has been all but rejected.

rules.zh: 目標表達【all but】可以出現在不同類型的子句中它不必每次都放在一個簡單句的最後。主要子句大橋工程差不多完成。 句首從屬子句雖然道路幾乎無法通行，司機仍繼續前進。 轉述或內嵌子句專家相信該火山幾乎已停止活動。 關係子句那間幾乎已被遺忘的舊戲院重新開業了。 複合句的後半部分村莊看起來沒有改變，但其傳統生活方式幾乎已經消失。
rules.en: all but Main clause The bridge is all but complete. Opening subordinate clause Although the road was all but impassable, the driver continued. Reported or embedded clause Experts believe that the volcano is all but inactive. Relative clause The old cinema, which was all but forgotten, has reopened. Second part of a compound sentence The village looks unchanged, but its traditional way of life is all but gone.

rules.zh: 不一定是簡單名詞例句 X：可以是：。人或事物球員差不多準備好了。 較長的名詞詞組兩個設計之間的分別幾乎看不見。 子句（A clause；從前看來未能確定的事情，現在幾乎已成定局。） 使用不同類型的主語，可以讓句式更自然，避免所有答案採用完全相同的排列方式。
rules.en: X A person or thing The player is all but ready. A longer noun phrase The difference between the two designs is all but invisible. What once seemed doubtful is now all but certain.

rules.zh: 不要把這個用法與【all but + noun】混淆。當 all but 放在名詞或數量詞前面時，它可以表示：【everyone or everything except】 除了……之外的所有人或事物除了兩名學生外，其他學生都通過了測驗。 這裏的 all but two students 不是「幾乎兩名學生」。它的意思是：【all the students except two】 除了兩名學生外的所有學生比較：【The task is all but complete.】 任務差不多完成。 除了一項任務外，其他任務都已完成。 本練習只集中學習：【be + all but + adjective / past participle】。現在式：協議差不多已經定案。 物資幾乎耗盡。 過去式：城鎮當時幾乎空無一人。 畫作當時幾乎完全損毀。 完成式或被動式：這種疾病幾乎已被消除。 該項目當時幾乎已被放棄。 將來式或情態動詞：建築工程很快便會差不多完成。 要取得勝利幾乎不可能。
rules.en: everyone or everything except All but two students passed the test. all the students except two The task is all but complete. All but one task is complete. be + all but + adjective / past participle 1. Present form Subject + is / am / are + all but + adjective / past participle. The agreement is all but final. The supplies are all but exhausted. 2. Past form Subject + was / were + all but + adjective / past participle. The town was all but deserted. The painting was all but ruined. 3. Perfect or passive form Subject + has / have / had been + all but + past participle. The disease has been all but eliminated. The project had been all but abandoned. 4. Future or modal form Subject + will / may / would + be + all but + adjective / past participle. The building will soon be all but complete. Victory would be all but impossible.

rules.zh: 配合不定詞補語這部機器幾乎不可能修理。 這個計劃幾乎肯定會失敗。 和 to fail 是補充相關形容詞意思的部分，不是 all but 的固定組成部分。放在另一個子句內經理承認原來的時間表幾乎不可行。 放在關係子句內那座幾乎已被遺忘的舊建築已經完成修復。
rules.en: With an infinitive complement Subject + be + all but + adjective + to + verb. The machine is all but impossible to repair. The plan is all but certain to fail. to repair 6. Inside another clause Subject + reporting verb + that + subject + be + all but... The manager admitted that the schedule was all but unworkable. 7. In a relative clause Noun, which + be + all but..., + main clause. The old building, which was all but forgotten, has been restored.

rules.zh: 配合可選的句首資料經過多次延誤後，公眾信心幾乎完全消失。 句首資料提供時間、原因、條件或對比，但核心句式仍然是：【public confidence was all but destroyed】
rules.en: With optional introductory information After / before / without / although / once + information, subject + be + all but... After repeated delays, public confidence was all but destroyed. public confidence was all but destroyed

benefits.zh: 表達事情非常接近完成狀態以【all but】為例：比一般的 very 更準確。這句並不自然，因為 complete 通常表示「完成」或「未完成」。較自然的說法是：【The work is all but complete.】 工作差不多完成。 它清楚表示只剩很少部分尚未完成。
benefits.en: The work is very complete. The work is all but complete.

benefits.zh: 表達「實際上差不多如此，但並非百分之百」這個句型適合描述一件事情在技術上仍未完全發生，但實際情況已經非常接近。建議幾乎已被否決。 這可能表示正式投票尚未進行，但大部分人已經反對，結果幾乎沒有懸念。
benefits.en: The proposal has been all but rejected.

benefits.zh: 讓句子更簡潔沒有這個句型時，可能需要較長的解釋：【Only a very small amount of work remains before the building is complete.】 使用 all but 後，可以寫成：【The building is all but complete.】 建築工程差不多完成。 意思更集中，也更容易理解。
benefits.en: Only a very small amount of work remains before the building is complete. The building is all but complete.

benefits.zh: 避免不斷重複 almost 和 nearly 學生經常重複使用：【almost finished；almost impossible；nearly empty；nearly certain】 以【all but】為例：提供另一種自然表達，令作文、報告和討論中的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: almost finished almost impossible nearly empty nearly certain

benefits.zh: 適合表達接近定局的情況這個句型常適合描述：幾乎完成的工作；幾近耗盡的物資；幾乎肯定的結果；幾乎不可能完成的事情；接近消失的傳統；尚未正式決定但幾近定局的方案。例如：【The team’s place in the final is all but certain.】 球隊的決賽席位幾乎已成定局。
benefits.en: The team’s place in the final is all but certain.

benefits.zh: 可以靈活放入不同句型以【all but】為例：不必每次都放在簡單句的同一位置。你可以把它放入：主要子句；以【although】為例：子句；以【that】為例：子句；關係子句；複合句的後半部分。這能幫助你寫出較有變化的句子，而不是每次都使用：【Subject + is + adjective.】
